scientific_integrity: Finite signed simplicial trace enumerations reproduced by two distinct standard-library algorithms; homology concentration and rank 39 are an expressly cited premise from Scoville, not claimed as a new proof.
scientific_limitations: No integral representation theorem, equivariant homotopy equivalence, inclusion-induced isomorphism, or higher-simplex extension is established; possible unindexed prior computations remain.
title: Complete tetrahedral symmetry characters of generalized discrete Morse matching complexes
